Class UDFValueResolverRegistry

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.resolver.UDFValueResolverRegistry
@Service public class UDFValueResolverRegistry extends Object
Collects the resolver beans, parses and normalises the fill rule of the fill source RESOLVER, and resolves with an in-memory cache. ResolveOutcome.Found and ResolveOutcome.NotFound are cached for 24 hours under resolver, normalised argument and ISIN, so the fields of several users over the same instruments share one lookup. Provenance and writes stay per field; the cache never survives a restart.

      public String normalizeRule(String fillRule, UDFDataType udfDataType)
      Validates a rule for saving and returns it normalised: the resolver must exist and support the data type, and the argument is stored as returned by IUDFValueResolver.normalizeArgument(String).
      Parameters:
      fillRule - the rule as typed
      udfDataType - the data type of the field
      Returns:
      <resolverId> <normalised argument>
